tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250sman mchod ni/1$0000300 snang ba mtha' yas 'jig rten dbang phyug dang*// rdo rje sems dpa' gsang bdag rdo rje chos// dbang gi lha mo 'phags pa klu sgrub la// sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang dngos grub stsol// ma hā pañtsa a mṛta khā hi/ padma 'byung gnas mkhar chen mtsho rgyal ma// chos rgyal yab sras rgyal ba mchog gi dbyangs// chos blo'i rnam rol gter chen mchog gyur gling*// sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang dngos grub stsol// ma hā pañtsa a mṛta khā hi/ las can chos kyi bdag po bcu phrag sogs// bka' brgyud sgrub brgyud don brgyud 'dzin pa yi// rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma 'khor bcas la// sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang dngos grub stsol// ma hā pañtsa a mṛta khā hi/ rta mchog yab yum phyag brnyan khrag 'thung bzhi// zil gnon brgyad dang sgo srung dam can sogs// dbang chen 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang dngos grub stsol// ma hā pañtsa a mṛta khā hi/

dngos grub thig le gnas gsum du bkod la/ kā ya wā ka tsitta sarba siddhi pha la oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lcer myong la/ badzra a mṛta siddhi mme pra yatstsha/ bsam yas mchims phu gre gu dge'ur bsnyen sgrub 'brel 'jog bgyid skabs gu ṇas spel ba dge// /
